findings.finding: Timeseries H5 writer takes an already-parsed MagneticRegionsTimeSeries; it does not directly query native MotorCAD node positions. Upstream parser determines the provenance of node_xy and elements.
findings.implication: Live native per-step coordinate status remainsUNKNOWN until parser/export source is traced.

findings.finding: Reference first-step region elements fix tri_index/node1/node2/node3/reg_code. Later fields are aligned only by tri_index; unmatched IDs are silently skipped. The writer stores one connectivity table, not per-step connectivity.
findings.implication: Preserved tri_index values do not certify unchanged native per-step connectivity or remeshed a2 support. No exporter check here rejects duplicateIDs or proves per-step ID bijection.

findings.finding: Parsed bx/by are copied as floats and cast to output dtype. This writer applies no B rotation, BC sign, basis conversion or normalizer. Missing bx/by remainNaN; A/J/Je have separate zero defaults.
findings.implication: Physical Bframe/units must be proven upstream; dataset names bx/by alone do not establish lab frame. No target-driven sign fitting is allowed.

findings.finding: Moving nodes can be selected from explicit region codes, best-effort name prefixes/rotor text, or motion in last/middle steps with default1e-4mm tolerance. Coordinate-motion detection marks all nodes of a region when one moves. Method and codes are optionally recorded.
findings.implication: moving_selection_method is exporter selection provenance, not a solver-certified rotor/stator or sliding-interface definition. Motion selected from2 sampled phases is not full45 certification.

findings.finding: Reference and per-step coordinate arrays are copied from parsed node_xy. Missing moving-node coordinates are backward-filled from first available coordinate and forward-filled from previous step; no per-entry fill-mask is serialized in this writer.
findings.implication: Finite HDF coordinates alone cannot distinguish measured/per-step-native coordinates from filled values. Audit raw export/parser missingness before claiming actual native support. No field-array invalidity is concluded by this code fact.

findings.finding: The supplied steps order is retained, first list entry defines reference; solution/time_s/rotate_step are copied from timeseries metadata withNaN/-1 for absent entries.
findings.implication: The writer does not validate chronological ordering or decide whether rotate_step is incremental or absolute. Upstream parser/format authority is required.

findings.finding: Reviewed timeseries writer serializes mesh coordinates/native IDs/region codes/fields and limited time/motion metadata, but no explicit sectorBC type/sign/angle, field basis, native seam pair map or solver-certified boundary trace.
findings.implication: Absence here is scoped to this writer. It does not mean the native solver lacksBC. Existing HDFschema evidence remains insufficient for structural admission.

findings.finding: Workflow calls export_magnetic_txt on mc with first/finalstep and columns; then get_magnetic_timeseries_from_file(key=time_index); then H5 writer. TXT parsing, rather than this writer, controls coordinate and field interpretation.
findings.implication: Fetch only named defining modules through magnetic.py imports. Do not execute these functions, which can access MotorCAD.

findings.finding: Current DOE H5 conversion can read existing postproc TXT, parse time_index and write by_step_moving_nodes float32 H5 with default parser choices.
findings.implication: No new solve is needed to understand code, but actual past invocation/config is unbound. Re-conversion is not authorized merely to create convenient boundary data.

findings.finding: Current solve workflow creates a case-local .mot, applies/readbacks variables, saves before and after solve, and writes doe_condition.json with base_mot/mot_path/results_root/mes_paths/readback/timestamp. Resolver uses that path or first .mot match.
findings.implication: The condition record is the next narrow lineage locator. Path/timestamp/readback alone do not hash-bind .mot/.mes/TXT/H5. Do not use the first globbed .mot as scientific identity.

findings.finding: No source-code or native-model SHA pin is written by the reviewed export path; current fetch hashes prove retrieved code bytes only.
findings.implication: Require original-generation receipt/log/codecommit/config/model+mesh/source hashes or equivalent immutable provenance. Matching function names/schema/mtime is insufficient.

next_narrow_requests: Fetch hash-pinned magnetic.py and magnetic_model.py as text, then only imported modules defining timeseries parser/TXT exporter; inspect coordinate reconstruction, B conversion, step metadata and export column contract.
Read admitted case40 meta.json and exact lineage manifest row; locate original case .mot/doe_condition/.mes/TXT by explicit saved paths and hashes, not a broad source scan.
Inspect native model/config header only after exact case binding; seek explicit appliedBC/sector transform and native boundary records, while preserving UNKNOWN if absent.
